# nb-studio project-manager

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## project-manager get

Get the project manager

The project manager’s settings: the agents it runs with (a first choice and a fallback), its allocation principles (null for the built-in ones, which `builtInPrinciples` holds) and how many runs agents’ comments may start on an issue within 24 hours; with the enabled agents it may run with. Anyone signed in may read them.

```bash
nb-studio project-manager get
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projectManager` (`projectManagerGet`)

## project-manager start

Hand an issue to the project manager

Wakes the project manager on an open issue it executes, as the current issue owner. Only that owner may invoke it, and needs `pm.issues` edit on the issue. Other callers receive `ISSUE_OWNER_START_REQUIRED`.

```bash
nb-studio project-manager start <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projectManager/issues/{issueId}/start` (`projectManagerStartIssue`)

## project-manager update

Update the project manager

Changes the agents the project manager runs with (enabled agents; the first choice also becomes the default chat agent), its allocation principles (null restores the built-in ones) and the comment run limit. Needs `agents.agents` manage.

```bash
nb-studio project-manager update
```

| Flag                                 | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`                             | string  | The persisted project manager name, 1–200 characters after trimming; independent of the viewer’s language.                                            |
| `--description`                      | string  | The persisted description, at most 10,000 characters; null, an empty string or whitespace clears it. (or --description-file <path>)                   |
| `--delegation-queue-timeout-seconds` | integer | Seconds a manager-delegated step may remain queued before withdrawal and an automatic reply (default 600); changes apply on the next sweep.           |
| `--fallback-after-seconds`           | integer | Seconds the first choice may wait in the runnable queue before an idle fallback can claim it (default 120).                                           |
| `--first-choice`                     | string  | The enabled agent whose tool and model the project manager runs with.                                                                                 |
| `--fallback`                         | string  | The enabled agent it runs with after the first choice queue delay, or immediately when no compatible runner can take the first choice; null for none. |
| `--principles`                       | string  | The allocation principles; null (or the built-in text) restores the built-in ones. (or --principles-file <path>)                                      |
| `--comment-run-limit`                | integer | How many runs agents’ comments may start on one issue within 24 hours before its owner is asked to continue.                                          |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projectManager` (`projectManagerUpdate`)
